def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    for tile_y in range(3):
        for y in range(h):
            source_y = y if tile_y == 1 else (h - 1 - y if tile_y == 0 else h - 1 - y)

                for x in range(w):

                    row.append(grid[source_y][source_x])
            out.append(row)
    return out
